title: Ask Richter
subtitle: AI Career Agent & Tri-Retrieval Engine (Sanity Content Lake)
summary: AI Career Agent with ontological modeling on Sanity Content Lake (101 docs/121 references), Tri-Retrieval Engine architecture (M2 GROQ, M3 Semantic Embeddings, M4 Agentic Graph), and a suite of 170 automated tests.
overview:
A traditional resume recounts past experiences statically, but what if your professional career could be queried as a living, relational, and auditable knowledge base in real time? Ask Richter transcends the conventional portfolio concept: it is a multilingual AI Career Agent (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) grounded on a Tri-Retrieval Engine architecture and ontological modeling on the Sanity Content Lake.

The core architectural differentiator lies in the transition from a traditional flat-text RAG to a strongly typed, interconnected dataset containing 101 documents and 121 references. Operating under the fundamental premise "Retrieve evidence first. Generate second. Abstain when there is no evidence", the system prevents hallucinations via intelligent intent routing: M2 (Structured GROQ), M3 (Semantic Embeddings), and M4 (Agentic Knowledge Graph Bounded Traversal).

The entire infrastructure operates 100% Serverless (Next.js 15 App Router on Vercel), combined with the Sanity MCP server in the engineering environment, Google GenAI (Gemini 3.6-flash) integration, and deterministic pure TypeScript fallback (TSVectorStore).
roleDescription: As AI Solutions Architect & Lead Full-Stack Engineer, I worked end-to-end on the system design, ontological modeling, and software engineering:
responsibilities: AI & Knowledge Solutions Architect: Modeled the career ontology in Sanity Content Lake (schemas: skill, experience, project, education, achievement, architectureDecision), formalizing 121 structured references and ADR-0010 (Tri-Retrieval Engine).
AI Engineer: Implemented the 3 retrieval engines (declarative GROQ, semantic dataset embeddings, and agentic multi-hop KnowledgeGraphRetriever), enforcing strict Factual Abstention.
Full-Stack Developer: Built the serverless backend on Next.js 15 App Router with resilient /api/chat routes and reactive UI in React 19 with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Reliability Engineer (SRE/DevOps): Built the automated Jidoka/Turborepo pipeline, ensuring strict typing, workspace isolation, and official Sanity MCP integration for autonomous agent auditing.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Overcoming Flat-Text RAG and Complex Relationships: Conventional vector RAG pipelines struggled with exact relational queries, project cardinality, or exhaustive categorical lists.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Architected the Tri-Retrieval Engine (ADR-0010) on top of Sanity Content Lake: deterministic queries route to GROQ (M2), open-ended questions to Semantic Embeddings (M3), and relational queries to Graph Traversal (M4).

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Agentic Loop Bounds and Execution Control: Autonomous agent traversals in knowledge graphs risk context drift, unbounded latency, and recursive loops.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Established strict deterministic execution invariants (Bounded Execution): maximum of 2 hops, ceiling of 4 tool calls, 4,000ms global timeout, cycle detection, and strictly read-only execution (Zero Mutation).

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Serverless Resilience and Native C++ Dependency Elimination: Heavy C++ binaries (FAISS) compromised bundling size and cold-start predictability in Serverless runtimes.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Engineered pure TypeScript TSVectorStore for in-memory 768-dimensional vector operations as a resilient fallback layer, combined with a 7-state Operational State Machine (ADR-0009) for database recovery.

futureEvolution: RAG Relevance Telemetry: Implement advanced observability dashboards to measure implicit relevance feedback and ranking accuracy across retrieval engines.
Expanded Bidirectional Multi-Hop Graph: Enhance support for reverse graph traversals within the strict 4-second latency budget.

owaspMitigations.title: Broken Access Control (Zero Mutation in Agentic Environments)
owaspMitigations.description: The M4 agent operates strictly with read-only tools, preventing any document creation, modification, or deletion in the Content Lake.

owaspMitigations.title: Cryptographic Failures (Strict Secret & Token Isolation)
owaspMitigations.description: Communication with Sanity API and Supabase Management API is strictly server-side. Master tokens and API keys are never leaked to client browsers.

owaspMitigations.title: Injection & SSRF (Sanitized Queries & Invariant Routing)
owaspMitigations.description: GROQ queries (M2) are typed and parameterized without string interpolation. URLs are runtime-sanitized to enforce native relative routes.
